item.title: AMBER Alert leads to safe return of Minnesota girl, man arrested
item.description: ZIMMERMAN, Minn. (KVRR) — A man is jailed in Sherburne County, Minnesota for abducting a 7-year-old girl on Wednesday in Zimmerman.
